summary: The exact candidate implements the requested unified GatewayConfig and startup-lifecycle refactor and preserved the independently checked CLI/default/routing contract. A fresh pinned-toolchain build and all 344 candidate library tests passed. The candidate's shutdown fix is valid in its final code, although its reported failing-before state came from an intermediate imported proposal rather than the recorded campaign base, which also shut down promptly in the minimal independent check.

tests.what_was_measured: Recorded-base regression baseline: 392 library tests passed and the checkout exactly matched the required base. The source still contains split RouterConfig/ServerConfig and distributed startup wiring.
Exact-candidate regression suite: 344 passed, including direct/launch CLI equivalence, defaults, PD bootstrap validation, transport compatibility, and shutdown notification tests.
Fresh native Rust gateway binary built from the exact candidate with repository-pinned rustc 1.90.0; binary copied to the private runtime before switching revisions.

tests.command: extract and compare sorted long options from rebuilt base/candidate binaries for --help and launch --help
tests.what_was_measured: No existing direct or launch long option was removed. The candidate added version flags and made --prefill visible in launch help. Full textual help differs due to grouping and formatting.
The rebuilt candidate received SIGINT and stopped promptly at 3063 ms with no health-checker timeout warning; timeout returns 124 because it initiated the signal.
The recorded base also stopped promptly at 3055 ms in this minimal no-worker case, so the candidate report's 10-second failing-before shutdown was not reproduced against the required recorded base.

gpu_execution.evidence: No GPU code changed. This is a Rust gateway configuration/control-plane refactor; GPU numerical validation is not applicable. Prepared Torch/ROCm remained untouched.

native_rebuild_evidence: Built /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-6887cc79907b/candidate-gateway from exact commit da7442bd with pinned rustc 1.90.0. No FlyDSL/C++ sources or Python native extension sources changed.
remaining_limitations: No Kubernetes cluster, live multi-node mesh, production WASM component, TLS deployment, Redis executable fixture, or real model worker was available for end-to-end validation.

The candidate library suite has 48 fewer tests than the base because in-tree mesh/WASM implementations and associated unit tests were removed/delegated; package integration compiled, but those externalized paths were not independently qualified end to end.
The prepared image initially lacked the cargo path cited in the candidate report. A private rustup installation of the repository-pinned 1.90.0 toolchain was required.
The host is x86_64 with ROCm 7.2 available, but no GPU was used because the candidate changes no GPU/native-kernel path.
